sql_log.purpose: Search for exact screen+source-snapshot pairs across adjacent late revisions to test a causal performance comparison.
sql_log.sql:
with a as (
  select id,pantalla_id,source_snapshot_sha256,curator_duration_ms,validator_duration_ms
  from programacion.input_readiness_runs
  where created_at < timestamptz '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00'
    and contract_revision='5.13'
), b as (
  select id,pantalla_id,source_snapshot_sha256,curator_duration_ms,validator_duration_ms
  from programacion.input_readiness_runs
  where created_at < timestamptz '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00'
    and contract_revision='5.13.1'
), pairs as (
  select a.id as a_id,b.id as b_id,a.pantalla_id,a.source_snapshot_sha256,
         a.curator_duration_ms as a_curator_ms,b.curator_duration_ms as b_curator_ms,
         a.validator_duration_ms as a_validator_ms,b.validator_duration_ms as b_validator_ms
  from a join b using (pantalla_id,source_snapshot_sha256)
)
select
  count(*) as exact_screen_snapshot_pairs,
  count(*) filter (where a_curator_ms>0 and b_curator_ms>0) as curator_comparable_pairs,
  count(*) filter (where a_validator_ms>0 and b_validator_ms>0) as validator_comparable_pairs,
  jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('a_id',a_id,'b_id',b_id,'pantalla_id',pantalla_id,
    'a_curator_ms',a_curator_ms,'b_curator_ms',b_curator_ms,
    'a_validator_ms',a_validator_ms,'b_validator_ms',b_validator_ms)
    order by pantalla_id,a_id,b_id) as pairs
from pairs
